'''Lumia'Silbossa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] female who resided on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Like so many female Twi'leks, Lumia was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] during her adolescent years. It was not until Lumia was older that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] rescued her from her life as a slave. Like all the slaves that Master Thorla rescued, he offered Lumia a place at his refuge called [[The Enclave]]. Lumia accepted the offer whole-heartedly and took up residence at Thorla's refuge. She soon became The Enclave's healer, tending to the all manor of wounds sustained by life in the [[Bright Lands]] of Ryloth. Lumia also showed a measure of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sensitivity which allowed her to better assist those in need.
